summary: A small item batch, merges, and derives routine coordinator records. One record_verdict call carries a verdict object per approved predicate, each with its own actor, evidence, and kind, so CD-0012 D7 evaluator distinctness holds per verdict. The three break_fix diagnosis records merge into one record_diagnosis action whose required sections carry the CD-0156 payload guards, and the alignment step narrows to workflow.implementation. The start of repair and refine derives from the first action at the step under the CD-0183 D2 derivation, keeping the epoch, the fence, and the CD-0192 refine bound. An accepted report that carries the delivery artifact folds the same typed delivery event CD-0166 D1 keeps coordinator-owned. The worker-failure record derives from the attempt terminal event, and reject_worker_result can carry the retry dispatch behind the CD-0173 escalation wall. Each decision names one implementation item; the record implements nothing.
title: Small items batch, merge, and derive routine workflow actions
